```{r}
# 1. LOAD PACKAGES
# ============================================================

library(glmnet)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(broom)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r}
# 2. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

# Clinical data
clinical <- read_excel(
  ".../TCGA-CDR-SupplementalTableS1.xlsx",
  sheet = 1
)

# RNA-seq data
expr_raw <- read.delim(
  ".../EBPlusPlusAdjustPANCAN_IlluminaHiSeq_RNASeqV2.geneExp.tsv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# IDH status
idh_data <- read_excel(
  ".../ijms-2057006_TableS2.xlsx",
  sheet = 1
)

```

```{r}
# 3. CLEAN PATIENT IDENTIFIERS
# ============================================================

# Rename IDH identifier to match clinical data
colnames(idh_data)[colnames(idh_data) == "Case_ID"] <-
  "bcr_patient_barcode"

# Standardize patient identifiers
clinical$bcr_patient_barcode <-
  toupper(trimws(clinical$bcr_patient_barcode))

idh_data$bcr_patient_barcode <-
  toupper(trimws(idh_data$bcr_patient_barcode))


# ============================================================
# 4. MERGE CLINICAL + IDH DATA
# ============================================================

merged_data <- merge(
  idh_data,
  clinical,
  by = "bcr_patient_barcode",
  all.x = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# 4. MERGE CLINICAL + IDH DATA
# ============================================================

merged_data <- merge(
  idh_data,
  clinical,
  by = "bcr_patient_barcode",
  all.x = TRUE
)

```
```{r}
# 5. PROCESS RNA-SEQ DATA
# ============================================================

expr_data <- as.data.frame(expr_raw)

# Separate gene symbol and Entrez ID
expr_data_clean <- expr_data %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    gene_id,
    into = c("gene_symbol", "entrez_id"),
    sep = "\\|"
  )

# Remove duplicate gene symbols
expr_data_nodup <- expr_data_clean %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Convert to patient x gene format
expr_tidy <- expr_data_nodup %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol") %>%
  select(-entrez_id) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("barcode")

```
```{r}
# 6. CLEAN RNA-SEQ BARCODES
# ============================================================

# Remove the first non-patient/header row if present
expr_tidy <- expr_tidy[-1, ]

# Convert periods to hyphens
expr_tidy$barcode <- gsub(
  "\\.",
  "-",
  expr_tidy$barcode
)

# Retain first three barcode components
expr_tidy$barcode <- sapply(
  strsplit(expr_tidy$barcode, "-"),
  function(x) paste(x[1:3], collapse = "-")
)

```
```{r}
# 7. MERGE CLINICAL AND RNA-SEQ DATA
# ============================================================

merged <- inner_join(
  merged_data,
  expr_tidy,
  by = c("bcr_patient_barcode" = "barcode")
)

```

```{r}
# 8. FILTER FOR IDH-MUTANT ASTROCYTOMA
# ============================================================

merged_filtered <- merged %>%
  filter(`IDH status` == "Mutant")


```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
  filter(
    !is.na(OS.time),
    !is.na(OS),

  )

merged_filtered_pfi_clean <- merged_filtered %>%

```
```{r}

# ============================================================

  merged_filtered_clean$`TCGA Grade`,
  levels = c("G2", "G3", "G4")
)

merged_filtered_pfi_clean$`TCGA Grade` <- factor(
  merged_filtered_pfi_clean$`TCGA Grade`,
  levels = c("G2", "G3", "G4")

```

```{r}
# 12. CREATE EXPRESSION MATRICES
# ============================================================

# OS
x_os <- merged_filtered_clean %>%
  select(all_of(genes_of_interest)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

x_os <- log2(x_os + 1)

y_os <- Surv(
  merged_filtered_clean$OS.time,
  merged_filtered_clean$OS
)


# PFS
x_pfs <- merged_filtered_pfi_clean %>%
  select(all_of(genes_of_interest)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

x_pfs <- log2(x_pfs + 1)

y_pfs <- Surv(
  merged_filtered_pfi_clean$PFI.time,
  merged_filtered_pfi_clean$PFI
)

```
```{r}
# 13. TRAIN / TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

train_idx_os <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(x_os)),
  size = floor(0.75 * nrow(x_os))
)

test_idx_os <- setdiff(
  seq_len(nrow(x_os)),
  train_idx_os

set.seed(123)

train_idx_pfs <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(x_pfs)),
  size = floor(0.75 * nrow(x_pfs))
)

test_idx_pfs <- setdiff(
  seq_len(nrow(x_pfs)),
  train_idx_pfs
)

# OS
x_train_os <- x_os[train_idx_os, ]
x_test_os  <- x_os[test_idx_os, ]

y_train_os <- y_os[train_idx_os]
y_test_os  <- y_os[test_idx_os]


# PFS

y_test_pfs  <- y_pfs[test_idx_pfs]


# Grade

  test_idx_os

grade_test_pfs <- merged_filtered_pfi_clean$`TCGA Grade`[
```

```{r}
lasso_os <- cv.glmnet(
  x_train_os,
  y_train_os,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)


set.seed(123)

lasso_pfs <- cv.glmnet(
```

```{r}
# 16. ELASTIC-NET COX REGRESSION
# ============================================================

alphas <- seq(
  0.05,
  0.95,
  by = 0.05
)


find_best_elastic_net <- function(x_train, y_train, alphas) {

  results <- vector(
    "list",
    length(alphas)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(alphas)) {

    set.seed(123)

    cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
      x_train,
      y_train,
      family = "cox",
      alpha = alphas[i],
      nfolds = 10
    )

    results[[i]] <- list(
      alpha = alphas[i],
      model = cv_fit,
      cv_error = min(cv_fit$cvm)
    )
  }

  cv_errors <- sapply(
    results,
    function(x) x$cv_error
  )

  best <- results[[which.min(cv_errors)]]

  return(best)
}


enet_os <- find_best_elastic_net(
  x_train_os,
  y_train_os,
  alphas
)

enet_pfs <- find_best_elastic_net(
  x_train_pfs,
  y_train_pfs,
  alphas
)
# Display selected alpha values
cat(
  "Best elastic-net alpha, OS:",
  enet_os$alpha,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Best elastic-net alpha, PFS:",
  enet_pfs$alpha,
  "\n"
)


# Extract actual glmnet models
enet_os_model <- enet_os$model
enet_pfs_model <- enet_pfs$model
```
```{r}
# 17. EXTRACT NON-ZERO COEFFICIENTS
# ============================================================

get_nonzero_coefs <- function(model, gene_names) {

  coefs <- coef(
    model,
    s = "lambda.min"
  )

  data.frame(
    Gene = gene_names[coefs@i + 1],
    Coefficient = as.numeric(coefs@x)
  )
}


lasso_os_coefs <- get_nonzero_coefs(
  lasso_os,
  colnames(x_os)
)

lasso_pfs_coefs <- get_nonzero_coefs(
  lasso_pfs,
  colnames(x_pfs)
)

enet_os_coefs <- get_nonzero_coefs(
  enet_os_model,
  colnames(x_os)
)

enet_pfs_coefs <- get_nonzero_coefs(
  enet_pfs_model,
  colnames(x_pfs)
)


# View coefficients
lasso_os_coefs
lasso_pfs_coefs
enet_os_coefs
enet_pfs_coefs
```

```{r}
# 18. PLOT COEFFICIENTS
# ============================================================

plot_coefs <- function(df, title) {

  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = Coefficient,
      y = reorder(Gene, Coefficient)
    )
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = 0,
        xend = Coefficient,
        yend = Gene
      ),
      color = "gray"
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Coefficient",
      y = "Gene"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}


grid.arrange(
  plot_coefs(
    lasso_pfs_coefs,
    "LASSO Cox regression coefficients for PFS"
  ),
  plot_coefs(
    lasso_os_coefs,
    "LASSO Cox regression coefficients for OS"
  ),
  plot_coefs(
    enet_pfs_coefs,
    "Elastic-net Cox regression coefficients for PFS"
  ),
  plot_coefs(
    enet_os_coefs,
    "Elastic-net Cox regression coefficients for OS"
  ),
  ncol = 2
)
```

```{r}
# 27. FUNCTION TO EXTRACT HR, CI, P-VALUE AND C-INDEX
# ============================================================

extract_cox_results <- function(model, model_name) {

  s <- summary(model)

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Variable = rownames(s$coefficients),
    HR = s$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
    CI_lower = s$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
    CI_upper = s$conf.int[, "upper .95"],
    P_value = s$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    C_index = s$concordance[1],
    C_index_SE = s$concordance[2]
  )
}
```

```{r}
# 32. KAPLAN-MEIER ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

make_km_plot <- function(
    data,
    time,
    event,
    score,
    label
) {

  df <- data[, c(time, event, score)]

  colnames(df) <- c(
    "time",
    "event",
    "score"
  )

  cut <- surv_cutpoint(
    df,
    time = "time",
    event = "event",
    variables = "score"
  )

  df$risk_group <- surv_categorize(cut)$score

  surv_fit <- survfit(
    Surv(time, event) ~ risk_group,
    data = df
  )

  ggsurvplot(
    surv_fit,
    data = df,
    pval = TRUE,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    palette = c("#1f78b4", "#e31a1c"),
    legend.labs = c("Low", "High"),
    title = paste("KM Curve:", label)
  )
}

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# REGULARIZED MODEL COEFFICIENTS
# ============================================================

extract_glmnet_coefs <- function(model, model_name, genes) {
  
  # Extract coefficient matrix at lambda.min
  coef_matrix <- as.matrix(coef(model, s = "lambda.min"))
  
  # Convert to data frame
  coef_df <- data.frame(
    Gene = rownames(coef_matrix),
    Coefficient = as.numeric(coef_matrix[, 1]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Keep only non-zero coefficients
  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    filter(Coefficient != 0)
  
  # Add model name
  coef_df$Model <- model_name
  
  # Reorder columns
  coef_df <- coef_df %>%
    select(Model, Gene, Coefficient)
  
  return(coef_df)
}

# Extract coefficients
coef_lasso_os <- extract_glmnet_coefs(
  lasso_os,
  "LASSO OS",
  genes_of_interest
)

coef_lasso_pfs <- extract_glmnet_coefs(
  lasso_pfs,
  "LASSO PFS",
  genes_of_interest
)

coef_enet_os <- extract_glmnet_coefs(
  enet_os,
  "Elastic Net OS",
  genes_of_interest
)

coef_enet_pfs <- extract_glmnet_coefs(
  enet_pfs,
  "Elastic Net PFS",
  genes_of_interest
)

# Combine
regularized_coefficients <- bind_rows(
  coef_lasso_os,
  coef_lasso_pfs,
  coef_enet_os,
  coef_enet_pfs
)

# Round coefficients for presentation
regularized_coefficients <- regularized_coefficients %>%
  mutate(Coefficient = round(Coefficient, 4))

regularized_coefficients
```

```{r}
  data = test_data_os

  Surv(PFS_time, PFS_event) ~ lasso_pfs_score,
  data = test_data_pfs
)

  Surv(OS_time, OS_event) ~ enet_os_score,
  data = test_data_os
)

cox_enet_pfs <- coxph(
  Surv(PFS_time, PFS_event) ~ enet_pfs_score,
  data = test_data_pfs
)
```

```{r}
extract_performance <- function(model, outcome, model_name, n, events) {
  
  s <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Model = model_name,
    N = n,
    Events = events,
    HR = exp(coef(model))[1],
    CI_lower = exp(confint(model))[1, 1],
    CI_upper = exp(confint(model))[1, 2],
    P_value = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    C_index = s$concordance[1],
    C_index_SE = s$concordance[2]
  )
}
```


```{r}
extract_grade_performance <- function(model, outcome, model_name, n, events) {
  
  s <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Model = model_name,
    N = n,
    Events = events,
    HR = NA,
    CI_lower = NA,
    CI_upper = NA,
    P_value = s$logtest["pvalue"],
    C_index = s$concordance[1],
    C_index_SE = s$concordance[2]
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# C-INDEX COMPARISON — TEST SET
# ============================================================

cindex_df <- data.frame(
  Outcome = c(
    "OS", "OS", "OS", "OS", "OS",
    "PFS", "PFS", "PFS", "PFS", "PFS"
  ),
  
  Model = c(
    "LASSO",
    "LASSO + Grade",
    "Elastic Net",
    "Elastic Net + Grade",
    "TCGA Grade",
    "LASSO",
    "LASSO + Grade",
    "Elastic Net",
    "Elastic Net + Grade",
    "TCGA Grade"
  ),
  
  C_index = c(
    0.5324841,
    0.7120000,
    0.5312102,
    0.71402878,
    0.7230216,
    
    0.5253378,
    0.5750000,
    0.5563063,
    0.59234234,
    0.5800882
  ),
  
  SE = c(
    0.10001324,
    0.09287651,
    0.09645093,
    0.09287651,
    0.07917231,
    
    0.06238601,
    0.06000000,
    0.05788830,
    0.05730145,
    0.06171913
  )
)

# Calculate 95% CI
cindex_df <- cindex_df %>%
  mutate(
    CI_lower = C_index - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_upper = C_index + 1.96 * SE,
    C_label = sprintf("%.3f", C_index)
  )

# Model order
cindex_df$Model <- factor(
  cindex_df$Model,
  levels = c(
    "TCGA Grade",
    "LASSO",
    "LASSO + Grade",
    "Elastic Net",
    "Elastic Net + Grade"
  )
)

# ============================================================
# PLOT
# ============================================================

ggplot(
  cindex_df,
  aes(
    x = C_index,
    y = Model
  )
) +
  
  # 95% CI
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = CI_lower,
      xmax = CI_upper
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    height = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # C-index point
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  # C-index value
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = C_label
    ),
    nudge_y = 0.23,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  # Chance level
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0.5,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Outcome,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Concordance index (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  # Long enough to accommodate the widest CI
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0.25, 0.85),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      10, 20, 10, 10
    )
  )
```
